# VLA Models & Skill Policies

> "System 1" vision-language-action models and skill policies a harness calls, including hierarchical and dual-system designs.  
> Layer: L1 · 85 entries · [overview](../README.md#policy) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- 🟡 [**Rho**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38164 "Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models") · 2026-09 · Microsoft — Family of open-weight bimanual VLAs with embodiment midtraining for YAM Box, UR AI Trainer and FR3 Duo; a lightweight latent policy learns from corrective feedback to pick noise inputs for the frozen flow-matching action expert, adapting online from a few corrected episodes. _Note: Base and embodiment-specific checkpoints released on Hugging Face (MIT); no training code link found._ [weights](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/rho-base)
- 🟢 [**Light-O1**](https://www.lightorigins.com/en/blog/light-o1) · 2026-09 · Light Origins — Embodied foundation model pretrained on structured human action recovered from internet video, then post-trained per embodiment; it states in language what an instruction needs from the body before generating actions. The open Light-O1-Preview covers text-to-whole-body action only. _Note: Preview release (Apache 2.0) lacks vision and manipulation; the full model is announced._ [code](https://github.com/lightorigins/Light-O1) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/LightOriginsHQ/Light-O1-Preview)
- 🟢 [**Grounded Action Model**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23863 "Grounded Action Model: 3D Grounding as a Foundation for Robotics") · 2026-09 — Robot foundation model built on 3D grounding: language, point or box prompts become an object-centric representation with metric geometry that a multi-stream transformer turns into action chunks; runs alone or as the low-level controller under a VLM planner. [code](https://github.com/GehaoZhang6/Grounded-Action-Model) · [project](https://grounded-action-model.github.io/)

[code](https://github.com/DeepCybo-PhysAI/ActionPiece) · [project](https://deepcybo-physai.github.io/ActionPiece/)

- 🟢 [**villa-X**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.23682 "villa-X: Enhancing Latent Action Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models") · 2025-07 · Microsoft Research — Vision-Language-Latent-Action (ViLLA) framework that improves how latent actions between frames are learned and injected into VLA pretraining, producing zero-shot latent action plans for unseen embodiments on gripper and dexterous-hand setups. [code](https://github.com/microsoft/villa-x) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/villa-x)
- ⚪ [**TRI Large Behavior Models (LBM)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05331 "A Careful Examination of Large Behavior Models for Multitask Dexterous Manipulation") · 2025-07 · Toyota Research Institute — Multitask diffusion-transformer policies pretrained on ~1,700 hours of real, simulated, UMI and Open X-Embodiment data and evaluated with blind randomized real-world trials and statistical testing; fine-tuned LBMs needed 3-5x less task data than single-task baselines. _Note: First-party evaluation; no public weights found._ [project](https://toyotaresearchinstitute.github.io/lbm1/)
- ⚪ [**Skild Brain**](https://www.skild.ai/blogs/building-the-general-purpose-robotic-brain) · 2025-07 · Skild AI — Omni-bodied robot foundation model meant to control quadrupeds, humanoids, tabletop arms and mobile manipulators; a low-frequency high-level manipulation and navigation policy feeds a high-frequency low-level policy, pretrained on large-scale simulation and internet video. _Note: Company blog only; no paper or weights._
- ⚪ [**GR-3**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15493 "GR-3 Technical Report") · 2025-07 · ByteDance Seed — 4B-parameter mixture-of-transformers VLA co-trained on web vision-language data, VR-collected human trajectories and robot data; deployed on the ByteMini bimanual mobile robot for long-horizon, dexterous and abstract-instruction tasks. [project](https://seed.bytedance.com/en/GR3)
- 🟢 [**Being-H0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15597 "Being-H0: Vision-Language-Action Pretraining from Large-Scale Human Videos") · 2025-07 · BeingBeyond — Dexterous VLA pretrained on large-scale human hand videos (motion capture, VR and RGB) through physical instruction tuning, with part-level motion tokenization for millimeter-accurate hand trajectories, then adapted to robot manipulation. [code](https://github.com/BeingBeyond/Being-H0) · [project](https://beingbeyond.github.io/Being-H0/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/BeingBeyond/Being-H0-1B-2508)
- 🟢 [**SmolVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01844 "SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics") · 2025-06 · Hugging Face — Compact 450M-parameter VLA trained on community-collected LeRobot datasets, designed to train on a single GPU and run on consumer hardware; adds an asynchronous inference stack that decouples action prediction from execution. [code](https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot) · [blog](https://huggingface.co/blog/smolvla) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/lerobot/smolvla_base)
- ⚪ [**Real-Time Chunking (RTC)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07339 "Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies") · 2025-06 · Physical Intelligence — Inference-time algorithm for asynchronous execution of diffusion or flow VLAs: it generates the next action chunk while the current one executes, freezing committed actions and inpainting the rest, which makes execution robust to inference latency without retraining. _Note: No official code link in the paper; relevant to how a harness executes chunked VLA actions under latency._ [blog](https://www.pi.website/research/real_time_chunking)
- 🟢 [**GR00T N1.5**](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_5/) · 2025-06 · NVIDIA — Update to GR00T N1 that keeps an Eagle 2.5-based VLM frozen, adds the FLARE future-latent alignment objective so it can learn from human video, and mixes in DreamGen synthetic trajectories; NVIDIA reports much better language following on the GR-1 humanoid. [code](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.5-3B)
- ⚪ [**Gemini Robotics On-Device**](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-on-device-brings-ai-to-local-robotic-devices/) · 2025-06 · Google DeepMind — Gemini Robotics variant optimized to run locally on the robot without network connectivity; adapts to new tasks with 50-100 demonstrations and was transferred from ALOHA to a bi-arm Franka FR3 and Apptronik's Apollo humanoid. _Note: Model and SDK offered through a trusted tester program only._
- 🟢 [**Fast-in-Slow (FiS-VLA)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01953 "Fast-in-Slow: A Dual-System Foundation Model Unifying Fast Manipulation within Slow Reasoning") · 2025-06 · Peking University — Dual-system VLA that embeds the fast System 1 execution module inside the VLM-based System 2 by partially sharing parameters, runs the two at asynchronous frequencies and reaches 117.7 Hz control with 8-step action chunks. [code](https://github.com/CHEN-H01/Fast-in-Slow) · [project](https://fast-in-slow.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/chenhao01/fisvla)
- 🟢 [**UniVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06111 "UniVLA: Learning to Act Anywhere with Task-centric Latent Actions") · 2025-05 · The University of Hong Kong, OpenDriveLab, AgiBot — Derives task-centric latent actions from videos with a latent action model in DINO feature space, so a generalist policy can learn from cross-embodiment robot data and human video and be decoded to specific robots; reports beating OpenVLA with far less pretraining compute. _Note: Distinct from "Unified Vision-Language-Action Model" (arXiv 2506.19850), also abbreviated UniVLA._ [code](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/UniVLA)
- 🟡 [**OneTwoVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11917 "OneTwoVLA: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Adaptive Reasoning") · 2025-05 · Tsinghua University — Single VLA that adaptively switches between explicit reasoning at critical moments and acting on its latest reasoning otherwise, co-trained with synthetic embodied-reasoning data; targets long-horizon planning, error detection and recovery, and human-robot interaction. _Note: Code and data released; pretrained weights not found._ [code](https://github.com/Fanqi-Lin/OneTwoVLA) · [project](https://one-two-vla.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**Knowledge Insulating VLAs**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23705 "Knowledge Insulating Vision-Language-Action Models: Train Fast, Run Fast, Generalize Better") · 2025-05 · Physical Intelligence — Shows that naively attaching diffusion or flow-matching action experts to a VLM harms training speed and transfer of web knowledge, and proposes insulating the VLM backbone during VLA training; the recipe is used in π0.5 checkpoints. _Note: openpi ships a π0.5-DROID checkpoint trained with knowledge insulation, but not the insulated training code._ [blog](https://www.pi.website/research/knowledge_insulation)
- 🟢 [**Hume**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21432 "Hume: Introducing System-2 Thinking in Visual-Language-Action Model") · 2025-05 — Dual-system VLA in which System 2 samples several action candidates and picks one with a value-query head (value-guided thinking) at low frequency, while a lightweight System 1 performs cascaded action denoising asynchronously for dexterous control. [code](https://github.com/hume-vla/hume) · [project](https://hume-vla.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/Hume-vla/Hume-System2)
- 🟢 [**GraspVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03233 "GraspVLA: a Grasping Foundation Model Pre-trained on Billion-scale Synthetic Action Data") · 2025-05 · Galbot, Peking University — Grasping VLA pretrained entirely on SynGrasp-1B, a billion-frame photorealistic synthetic grasping dataset, with a chain-of-thought that combines autoregressive perception and flow-matching actions to transfer to open-vocabulary objects zero-shot. [code](https://github.com/PKU-EPIC/GraspVLA) · [project](https://pku-epic.github.io/GraspVLA-web/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/vegebirrd/GraspVLA)
- 🟢 [**π0.5 (pi0.5)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16054 "π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization") · 2025-04 · Physical Intelligence — π0 successor co-trained on heterogeneous data (multiple robots, web data, object detection and high-level subtask prediction) that performs long-horizon mobile manipulation such as cleaning kitchens and bedrooms in homes not seen during training. _Note: Base weights added to openpi in September 2025 (flow-matching head only)._ [code](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi) · [blog](https://www.pi.website/blog/pi05)
- 🟢 [**GR00T N1**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14734 "GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots") · 2025-03 · NVIDIA — Open dual-system VLA for humanoids: a VLM (System 2) interprets images and language while a diffusion-transformer module (System 1) generates real-time motor actions; trained on a mix of real robot trajectories, human videos and synthetic data. [code](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1-2B)
- 🟢 [**GO-1 (Genie Operator-1)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06669 "AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems") · 2025-03 · AgiBot, OpenDriveLab — Generalist policy trained on the AgiBot World dataset (1M+ trajectories, 217 tasks) that predicts latent action representations to exploit heterogeneous data before an action expert emits robot actions (the ViLLA design); reports gains over RDT on long-horizon dexterous tasks. _Note: The paper's primary contribution is the AgiBot World dataset; GO-1 weights were open-sourced in September 2025._ [code](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/AgiBot-World) · [blog](https://opendrivelab.com/OpenGO1/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/agibot-world/GO-1)
- ⚪ [**Gemini Robotics**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20020 "Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World") · 2025-03 · Google DeepMind — VLA built on Gemini 2.0 that directly controls robots for dexterous, open-vocabulary manipulation, introduced together with the Gemini Robotics-ER embodied-reasoning model; can be specialized to long-horizon tasks or new embodiments by fine-tuning. _Note: Available only to trusted testers and partners._ [blog](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-brings-ai-into-the-physical-world/)
- ⚪ [**CoT-VLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.22020 "CoT-VLA: Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models") · 2025-03 · NVIDIA, Stanford University, MIT — 7B VLA that autoregressively predicts future image frames as visual goals (a visual chain of thought) before generating a short action sequence to reach them; reports +17% over the prior state of the art in real-world manipulation. _Note: Results are first-party; no code link found._ [project](https://cot-vla.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**OpenVLA-OFT**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19645 "Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models: Optimizing Speed and Success") · 2025-02 · Stanford University — Optimized fine-tuning recipe for VLAs (parallel decoding, action chunking, continuous actions, L1 regression) applied to OpenVLA; raises LIBERO average success from 76.5% to 97.1% with 26x faster action generation and enables bimanual ALOHA control. _Note: Benchmark numbers are first-party._ [code](https://github.com/moojink/openvla-oft) · [project](https://openvla-oft.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/moojink/openvla-7b-oft-finetuned-libero-spatial)
- ⚪ [**Helix**](https://www.figure.ai/news/helix) · 2025-02 · Figure AI — Dual-system humanoid VLA: a 7B onboard VLM (System 2, 7-9 Hz) produces latent semantics that an 80M visuomotor policy (System 1) turns into 200 Hz control of a 35-DoF upper body; runs on embedded GPUs and can drive two robots collaborating.
- 🟢 [**DexVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05855 "DexVLA: Vision-Language Model with Plug-In Diffusion Expert for General Robot Control") · 2025-02 · Midea Group, East China Normal University — Pairs a VLM with a separately pretrained 1B-parameter diffusion action expert and an embodiment curriculum (cross-embodiment pretraining, embodiment alignment, task post-training); performs long-horizon tasks such as laundry folding from direct language prompts. _Note: Released weights are the pretrained diffusion expert (ScaleDP); the VLM is Qwen2-VL._ [code](https://github.com/juruobenruo/DexVLA) · [project](https://dex-vla.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/lesjie/scale_dp_h)
- 🟢 [**π0-FAST**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09747 "FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models") · 2025-01 · Physical Intelligence — FAST compresses action chunks with the discrete cosine transform so autoregressive VLAs can learn high-frequency dexterous skills; π0-FAST matches diffusion π0 while training up to 5x faster, and FAST+ is released as a universal action tokenizer. [code](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi) · [blog](https://www.pi.website/research/fast) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/physical-intelligence/fast)
- 🟢 [**SpatialVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.15830 "SpatialVLA: Exploring Spatial Representations for Visual-Language-Action Model") · 2025-01 · Shanghai AI Laboratory — VLA that injects 3D information through Ego3D position encoding and represents motion with adaptive action grids; pretrained on 1.1M real robot episodes, with grids that can be re-discretized to fine-tune to new robot setups. [code](https://github.com/SpatialVLA/SpatialVLA) · [project](https://spatialvla.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/IPEC-COMMUNITY/spatialvla-4b-224-pt)
- 🟢 [**SAM2Act**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.18564 "SAM2Act: Integrating Visual Foundation Model with A Memory Architecture for Robotic Manipulation") · 2025-01 · University of Washington, NVIDIA, Allen Institute for AI, Universidad Católica San Pablo — Multi-view robotic transformer policy that upsamples visual foundation-model (SAM2) features at multiple resolutions; its SAM2Act+ variant adds a SAM2-inspired memory bank, encoder and attention for spatial memory, and the paper introduces MemoryBench. _Note: Primarily a policy; its MemoryBench is one of the first memory-dependent manipulation benchmarks._ [code](https://github.com/sam2act/sam2act) · [project](https://sam2act.github.io/)

**2024**

- 🟢 [**CogACT**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.19650 "CogACT: A Foundational Vision-Language-Action Model for Synergizing Cognition and Action in Robotic Manipulation") · 2024-11 · Microsoft Research Asia, Tsinghua University — Componentized VLA in which a diffusion action transformer is conditioned on the VLM's output instead of quantizing actions into VLM tokens; reports large gains over OpenVLA in simulation and on real robots and adapts to new robots. _Note: Comparisons are first-party._ [code](https://github.com/microsoft/CogACT) · [project](https://cogact.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/CogACT/CogACT-Base)
- 🟢 [**π0 (pi0)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24164 "π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control") · 2024-10 · Physical Intelligence — VLA that attaches a flow-matching action expert to a pretrained VLM and is trained on data from several dexterous robot platforms; folds laundry, busses tables and assembles boxes, and can follow language commands issued by a high-level VLM policy. _Note: Base and fine-tuned checkpoints were later released through openpi._ [code](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi) · [blog](https://www.pi.website/blog/pi0)
- 🟢 [**RDT-1B**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07864 "RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation") · 2024-10 · Tsinghua University — 1.2B-parameter Robotics Diffusion Transformer for bimanual manipulation that pretrains on multi-robot data through a physically interpretable unified action space; fine-tuned on 6k+ bimanual episodes and reported to learn new skills from 1-5 demonstrations. [code](https://github.com/thu-ml/RoboticsDiffusionTransformer) · [project](https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt-robotics/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/robotics-diffusion-transformer/rdt-1b)
- ⚪ [**GR-2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06158 "GR-2: A Generative Video-Language-Action Model with Web-Scale Knowledge for Robot Manipulation") · 2024-10 · ByteDance Research — Generative video-language-action model pretrained on 38M internet video clips to capture world dynamics, then fine-tuned jointly for video generation and action prediction on robot trajectories; evaluated on 100+ manipulation tasks. [project](https://gr2-manipulation.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**HPT**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.20537 "Scaling Proprioceptive-Visual Learning with Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers") · 2024-09 · MIT, Meta FAIR — Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers share one policy trunk across embodiments, mapping each robot's proprioception and vision through embodiment-specific stems into a short token sequence; studies pretraining scaling over 52 datasets incl. simulation and human video. [code](https://github.com/liruiw/HPT) · [project](https://liruiw.github.io/hpt/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/liruiw/hpt-base)
- 🟢 [**CrossFormer**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.11812 "Scaling Cross-Embodied Learning: One Policy for Manipulation, Navigation, Locomotion and Aviation") · 2024-08 · UC Berkeley — Transformer policy trained on 900k trajectories from 20 embodiments that controls single- and dual-arm manipulators, wheeled robots, quadcopters and quadrupeds with the same weights, without manually aligning observation or action spaces. [code](https://github.com/rail-berkeley/crossformer) · [project](https://crossformer-model.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/rail-berkeley/crossformer)
- 🟢 [**OpenVLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09246 "OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model") · 2024-06 · Stanford, UC Berkeley, TRI, Google DeepMind, Physical Intelligence, MIT — 7B open-source VLA (Llama 2 backbone with fused DINOv2 and SigLIP vision features) trained on 970k Open X-Embodiment demonstrations; supports LoRA fine-tuning on consumer GPUs and quantized serving, and is the base model for later work such as OpenVLA-OFT. _Note: Reported advantage over the 55B RT-2-X (+16.5% absolute) is first-party._ [code](https://github.com/openvla/openvla) · [project](https://openvla.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/openvla/openvla-7b)

**2023**

- 🟢 [**Octo**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12213 "Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy") · 2023-12 · UC Berkeley, Stanford, CMU, Google DeepMind — Open transformer-based generalist policy with a diffusion action head, trained on 800k Open X-Embodiment trajectories; accepts language or goal-image instructions and can be fine-tuned to new sensors and action spaces within hours on consumer GPUs. _Note: Checkpoints first published December 2023; arXiv report May 2024._ [code](https://github.com/octo-models/octo) · [project](https://octo-models.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/rail-berkeley/octo-base-1.5)
- 🟢 [**GR-1**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.13139 "Unleashing Large-Scale Video Generative Pre-training for Visual Robot Manipulation") · 2023-12 · ByteDance Research — GPT-style policy pretrained on large-scale video generation, then fine-tuned to predict robot actions and future images from language, image history and robot state; improved CALVIN success from 88.9% to 94.9%. First model of the GR series. [code](https://github.com/bytedance/GR-1) · [project](https://gr1-manipulation.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**RT-2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15818 "RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control") · 2023-07 · Google DeepMind — Co-fine-tunes large vision-language models on robot trajectories and web VQA data, emitting actions as text tokens; introduced the term vision-language-action (VLA) model and showed emergent semantic reasoning such as choosing a rock as an improvised hammer. [project](https://robotics-transformer2.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**ACT (ALOHA)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.13705 "Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware") · 2023-04 · Stanford University — Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) predicts chunks of future actions with a generative transformer policy; paired with the low-cost ALOHA bimanual teleoperation rig, it learns fine tasks such as slotting a battery from about 10 minutes of demonstrations. [code](https://github.com/tonyzhaozh/act) · [project](https://tonyzhaozh.github.io/aloha/)
- 🟢 [**Diffusion Policy**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.04137 "Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion") · 2023-03 · Columbia University, Toyota Research Institute, MIT — Represents a visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising diffusion process over action sequences, with receding-horizon control and visual conditioning, to handle multimodal action distributions; the formulation underlies later models such as TRI's Large Behavior Models. [code](https://github.com/real-stanford/diffusion_policy) · [project](https://diffusion-policy.cs.columbia.edu/)

**2022**

- 🟢 [**RT-1**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.06817 "RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale") · 2022-12 · Google — Transformer policy that tokenizes camera images and language instructions and outputs discretized robot actions; trained on a large real-robot dataset spanning 700+ tasks to study how generalization scales with data size, model size and diversity. _Note: Repository ships TensorFlow checkpoints for three RT-1 variants._ [code](https://github.com/google-research/robotics_transformer) · [project](https://robotics-transformer1.github.io/)
